gaps.sentence: Only after the interview ___ I realise how nervous I had been.
gaps.explanation: Only after X did I realise… — inversion.

gaps.sentence: So convincing ___ her argument that even the sceptics agreed.
gaps.explanation: 'So convincing was her argument that …' — 'so + adj' fronted with inversion.

gaps.sentence: Little ___ they know that the deal had already collapsed.
gaps.explanation: Little did they know = they had no idea — emphatic idiom with inversion.

gaps.sentence: In no way ___ this decision reflect the views of the board.
gaps.explanation: 'In no way does this decision reflect …' — auxiliary 'does' + base verb.

gaps.sentence: So ferocious ___ the storm prove that three coastal villages were evacuated.
gaps.explanation: With the bare verb 'prove', the inversion takes do-support: did the storm prove.

gaps.sentence: ___ the committee reach a decision, we cannot proceed.
gaps.explanation: Fronting 'Until…' emphasises the condition blocking progress.

gaps.sentence: Nowhere ___ you find a better example of Gothic architecture.
Not since the winter of 1963 ___ temperatures dropped so low.
gaps.explanation: 'Not since 1963 have temperatures dropped …' — the only time from then until now.
